cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box; it's beside the van. Done. Remember my lesson about precise instructions?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. You've supplied a number. I'll move all twenty beside the van; that fulfills your request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Inside the van, please. The sofa has to fit too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, two more details. Boxes inside, sofa on top. You haven't asked to be able to sit on it yet; we'll cover that next lesson.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 precision lesson claims narrow completion; A3 grades the number while retaining wrong place; A5 still grades details but invents an irrelevant seating requirement.

relationship.evidence: B4 gives practical space requirement for its other load.

heightening.evidence: A5 supposed remaining loophole concerns using furniture during transport, not the actual move.

specificity.evidence: A1 van/twenty and B4 sofa are concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 next lesson teaches a requirement B has no demonstrated reason to need.
